doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: Gluck describes his dual role as producer and SNL mixer
summary: Gluck explains he produces and engineers in studios and has spent thirty years as an on-air music mixer and post-production hand at Saturday Night Live.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Josiah Gluck with me today. And I’ve been reading about you so I know what you do but I’d like to afford you the opportunity to explain it yourself. Because it’s a bit complicated.

Well it’s kind of a unique straddling of both worlds in that I do music producing and engineering and I’ve had a lot of experience working in recording studios with different artists. But also I’ve spent thirty years at Saturday Night Live and I’m one of the two on- air music mixers for the show and I also handle post-production duties with other people where we take care of repeats, and I’m also sometimes mixing music videos that are produced for the show. So it encompasses a lot of audio production.
